reference_roles.name: volume_reference
reference_roles.role: The user-provided farm-building screenshot supplies only the three-quarter top-down view, roof/canopy thickness, plane separation, and grounded weight. Do not copy its building, layout, palette, or pixels.

reference_roles.name: identity_reference
reference_roles.role: Preserve only the living oak identity, arched warehouse door, acorn/storage motifs, and green/warm-brown color family. Replace the flat illustration rendering.

common_contract.lighting: upper-left key light; bright canopy top, medium front trunk, dark narrow right wall and lower occlusion
common_contract.pixel_style: native logical pixel art with hard square clusters and no antialiasing
common_contract.palette: coherent palette designed to normalize to at most 64 visible RGB colors
common_contract.background: perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma key, without gradient, floor, reflection, or background shadow

concept_candidates.name: oak_warehouse_candidate_a
concept_candidates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 64-logical-pixel tower-defense plant-building sprite candidate. Input images: Image 1 is a viewpoint and volume reference only; Image 2 is an Oak Warehouse identity and palette reference only. Create one compact living oak warehouse in a clear three-quarter top-down game view. A broad leafy canopy forms a readable bright top plane; its darker front foliage overlaps a thick trunk-built front wall; show one narrow dark right-side wall, a deeply recessed arched wooden storage door, subtle brass hinges, a few restrained acorns, and tied timber storage bands. Make the base feel heavy and grounded with compact internal contact occlusion, entirely inside the building silhouette. Canvas 64x64 logical pixels, subject no larger than 60x62, bottom-centred, with every logical pixel rendered as a hard uniform square block. Upper-left light, limited palette suitable for <=64 colors. Perfectly flat #FF00FF background. No text, UI, ground tile, external cast shadow, extra object, blur, antialiasing, watermark, or copied reference architecture.

concept_candidates.name: oak_warehouse_candidate_b
concept_candidates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: alternate 64-logical-pixel Oak Warehouse sprite candidate. Input images: Image 1 supplies only volumetric plane separation; Image 2 supplies only living-oak warehouse identity. Design one compact ancient oak whose layered crown acts like a natural roof over a stout hollow trunk storehouse. Clearly separate the sunlit leaf roof plane, darker foliage fascia, front trunk facade, narrow shaded right wall, thick arched doorway rim, and deep dark door recess. Add only restrained acorn and timber-band details. Strong weighted base and occlusion must remain within the 2x2 footprint. Three-quarter top-down view, upper-left light, hard native pixel clusters, subject <=60x62 logical pixels on a 64x64 logical canvas, palette suitable for <=64 colors. Uniform #FF00FF background only. No text, UI, ground patch, external shadow, extra props, soft painting, antialiasing, watermark, or copied screenshot details.

selection.rule: Choose the candidate with the clearest top/front/right plane separation and cleanest readable 64px silhouette; do not average or blend candidates.
selection.refinement_spec: Refine candidate B only: preserve the exact living-oak warehouse identity, arched door, storage motifs, silhouette, upper-left light, and top/front/right plane separation; regularize the logical pixel clusters and pure #FF00FF background for clean keying; do not add ground, external shadow, text, UI, props, or new architecture.
selection.selected_source_action: Copy the refined candidate B byte-for-byte to selected_source without resizing or filtering before running the processor.
